messages:
Priya (Product): Quick capture from today's all-hands security office hours. Customers wanted a one-pager on KMS/BYOK rotation guarantees, HSM roadmap for Private, DSAR ownership, and ISO evidence timing. Can we thread answers here?
Leah (Head of Security): I'll keep it tight.
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK / rotation: we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated & Private. We recommend a 90-day rotation cadence but do not enforce automatic rewraps. If teams want automated rotation + rotation-proof artifacts, we have a paid "managed-rotation" option (opt-in).
Anya (Compliance): For SOC2/ISO evidence we need rotation events, key version history, and admin access trails. Plan: Console export (CSV) + an auditor-report bundle (ETA: August).
Kai (Eng-Infra): HSMs: on-prem HSMs supported via KMIP connector agent. Pilot plan: two customers in June; GA target end-of-Q3 if pilots pass perf/security checks. Connector requires HSM certs and network tunnel validation.
Jordan (CTO): We'll prioritize low-latency pilots first; any perf regressions block GA.
Sam (Privacy): DSARs: Hosted API defaults: we retain request metadata (timestamps, model, tokens). Request/response content is not stored unless the customer enables logging. For Private/Dedicated where the customer controls KMS/network/storage, the customer owns DSAR responses for data in their environment. Redwood will provide metadata exports and a timeboxed assistance window per contract.
Priya (Product): Customers also asked about immutable audit copies and auditor access patterns.
Kai (Eng-Infra): We can stream audit logs to customer-owned buckets (S3/GCS) with versioning + lifecycle rules. For WORM/immutable semantics customers should enable provider-side object locking; we'll publish recipe docs. We can also provide a read-only "auditor SSO" link for self-serve access to evidence bundles (planned feature).
Maya (Legal): For auditor SSO we need legal guardrails (TOS toggle, auditor NDA checkbox). We'll draft the clause.
Leah (Head of Security): Security caveat: HSM-backed keys that never leave the module mean some traces live only in the HSM audit log. Customers must coordinate with their HSM operator for that evidence. We'll state this clearly in the FAQ.
Anya (Compliance): ISO evidence timeline (soft): June - export templates and sample CSVs; July - pilot evidence bundles for auditors; Aug - self-serve evidence bundles; Sept - auditor-access controls and documentation.
Priya (Product): Action items?
Leah (Head of Security): 1) Leah -> publish BYOK rotation FAQ and a one-paragraph DSAR ownership statement.
Kai (Eng-Infra): 2) Kai -> HSM connector pilot checklist + pilot signup form.
Anya (Compliance): 3) Anya -> ISO evidence export templates and sample bundles.
Maya (Legal): 4) Maya -> draft auditor-access legal toggle + NDA wording.
Priya (Product): Can someone file tickets so we can track delivery?
ticket-bot: Created SEC-9999 "BYOK rotation FAQ + DSAR policy"; SEC-10000 "HSM connector pilot checklist"; SEC-10001 "ISO evidence exports & auditor workflow"; SEC-10002 "Auditor SSO legal toggles".
Leah (Head of Security): I'll pick up SEC-9999.
Kai (Eng-Infra): I'll take SEC-10000 and start pilot outreach this week.
Anya (Compliance): I'll own SEC-10001.
Maya (Legal): I'll take SEC-10002 and sync with Priya.
Sam (Privacy): I'll draft the customer-facing DSAR blurb and paste in here in ~1hr. :thumbsup:
Priya (Product): Great. Once drafts are live I'll assemble a short external FAQ and share with Sales/SEs. Thanks all.
Leah (Head of Security): Closing the loop. For any NDA or partner-level architecture detail we'll coordinate via Legal/SEs.
ticket-bot: Updated SEC-9999 assigned to Leah, SEC-10000 assigned to Kai, SEC-10001 assigned to Anya, SEC-10002 assigned to Maya.
